summary: Christoff L-5 cab on Huckleberry Mountain near Greenwater, King County, Washington; removed or destroyed in 1958; reached today by Forest Service Trail 1171.

events.note: Forest Lookouts page lists panorama photos taken August 13, 1934; the blog gives 1934 as the build year

Blog author reached the old lookout site via Divide Ridge Trail 1172

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1935 for the L-5 cab, while the blog gives 1934 and a Forest Lookouts page lists panorama photos taken on August 13, 1934. The story reports both years and does not choose one.
The register says the cab was removed in 1958, while firelookout.com and the blog say it was destroyed that year. The story reports both words.

notes_for_editor: Brief record checks out: coordinates, 1,452 m elevation, King County and the October 17, 2010 registration match the register. The build year (1934 or 1935) and the 1958 end (removed or destroyed) conflict across sources, and the story reports both. No staffing source was read, so staffing is left out. The blog cites a Will Hite web page (willhiteweb.com, Christoff/Huckleberry Mountain) and a 1987 USFS cultural resource overview; neither was read and either could settle the build year or staffing. The 2012 blog visit and the FS trail page describe access but not the site's present condition beyond the blog's photos, which have no text description.
